nodes.name: Phasor
nodes.pitch: Build stores that answer exactly, replicas that sync by their differences and tables that repair themselves. One pass applies a thousand operators.

nodes.name: EvalApp
nodes.pitch: Run everything at once without overloading anything. Gates on every resource, sagas that undo failures, and a tuner that finds the right limit.

nodes.name: HoloDb
nodes.pitch: An embedded SQL database that learns from the queries it serves and keeps only what pays. Every answer is exact, with ACID and no index to design.

nodes.name: AlgFormer
nodes.pitch: A population of small holographic language models that talk through a shared wave, in pure managed code.

nodes.name: Prose
nodes.pitch: Three novels in, two thousand checked new sentences out. Mines grammar into HoloDb and recombines it into text and question and answer pairs.

nodes.name: HoloGenome
nodes.pitch: Turn DNA into a vector that winds like the real helix, then check it against laboratory measurements it never saw. The wins and the losses are published.

nodes.name: Tracer
nodes.pitch: Send a whole crowd to one exit with a single search. Navmesh pathfinding with dynamic obstacles, line of sight and combat.

nodes.name: HoloVoxel
nodes.pitch: Voxel worlds that stay crisp up close and cost almost nothing far away, with no mesh tiers and no popping.

nodes.name: Blazier
nodes.pitch: Blazor pages that read at once and download .NET only when a visitor presses Start, with long C# jobs in a Web Worker.
